diagnoses.description: 5 shampoos with harsh surfactants scored 29.5 points below expected. STRONG_DRY_SCALP_PENALTY (0.78) or STRONG_DAMAGED_PENALTY (0.82) may be too harsh, reducing even oily-hair profiles unnecessarily.
diagnoses.proposedFix: Raise STRONG_DRY_SCALP_PENALTY from 0.78 to 0.84. Raise STRONG_DAMAGED_PENALTY from 0.82 to 0.87.

diagnoses.description: 3 silicone-heavy products scored 12.9 points above expected. Buildup risk penalties for heavy silicones may be insufficient for curly/coily profiles.
diagnoses.proposedFix: In builtupAnalysis.ts: increase buildup score weight for 'Silicone' category ingredients on curlPattern=curly/coily profiles. Consider adding a 0.90 multiplier for 2+ silicones.

diagnoses.description: 9 low-porosity profiles with silicones scored 35.0 points below expected. Low-porosity penalty for silicones may be stacking excessively (molecular weight + buildup + advanced profile = triple penalty).
diagnoses.proposedFix: The MULTI_PENALTY_FLOOR=0.35 in scoreFormulation.ts should catch this. If still underrating, raise MULTI_PENALTY_FLOOR from 0.35 to 0.40 for Silicone category.

diagnoses.description: 13 sensitive-scalp profiles underrated by 29.5 pts. Scalp sensitivity may be stacking with cleanser harshness penalties.
diagnoses.proposedFix: Ensure MILD_SENSITIVE_SCALP_BONUS (1.08) in cleanserHarshness.ts is actually offsetting the scalp sensitivity penalty from advancedProfileModifiers.ts. Consider adding an explicit cap: max combined scalp penalty = ×0.75.
